newsitem.title: UK: No need for rate cut or tax cuts, CBI says.
newsitem.headline: No need for rate cut or tax cuts, CBI says.

text.p: Employers group the Confederation of British Industry said today there was no need for a further interest rate cut or tax cuts.
CBI director general Adair Turner said there was also no need for a pre-emptive rate rise at this point.
"We see no requirement to further stimulate the economy either monetarily or fiscally," he said.
"But given that inflation is clearly under control we see no need for immediate moves to raise rates either," he added.
Turner said the CBI expected underlying inflation to drop below 2.5 percent next year before rising but said consumer spending was now growing quite strongly.
Turner said without further tax and rate cuts consumer spending would grow around 4.0 percent next year.
